title: Pubspec that overrides a dependency
description: pubspec.yaml declares a `dependency_overrides` entry that replaces the declared constraint. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `dependency_overrides` entry that replaces the declared constraint.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a `dependency_overrides` entry that replaces the declared constraint.
limitation: It matches a `dependency_overrides` entry that replaces the declared constraint in the parsed pubspec.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
